chars.ADAM: ADAM: a Moroccan man around 31, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a white office shirt with a loosened navy tie and grey suit trousers
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a Moroccan woman around 29, long dark wavy hair, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a mustard-yellow knit sweater and wide light-blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a cosy modern apartment living room in Casablanca with a framed wedding photo on the wall. SALMA sits stiffly on the sofa avoiding his eyes, looking guilty, while ADAM stands holding his work bag, eyebrows raised, staring at her suspiciously. Awkward tension between the newlyweds.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, apartment building corridor in Casablanca. ADAM, tired but smiling, opens the front door of his apartment with his keys after work, work bag on his shoulder, warm light inside.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance hall. SALMA walks toward ADAM nervously, wringing her hands, forced small smile, while ADAM is taking off his shoes and looks up at her, curious.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Living room. ADAM and SALMA sit facing each other on the sofa. SALMA looks very serious and hesitant, ADAM leans in worried, asking if everything is okay. Tea glasses on a small table.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Living room close-up of both. SALMA, eyes down and ashamed, tells him something serious; ADAM is completely shocked, eyes wide, mouth open, frozen on the sofa. Comic dramatic moment.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: ADAM sits on the sofa holding his head with both hands, dizzy and stunned, cartoon swirl lines around his head, the living room tilted and blurry around him. Funny exaggerated expression.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Living room. ADAM laughs nervously and looks around the room searching for a hidden phone camera behind the curtains, pointing as if it is a prank for Instagram reels, while SALMA sits still with a dead serious face, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Living room, dim lamp light. SALMA holds ADAM's hand with both hands, pleading with guilty teary eyes, about to explain; ADAM sits frozen, staring at her in disbelief. Suspenseful mood.
